title: Spanish Tapas Board
description: A colorful platter of cured meats, cheeses, and garnishes that's perfect for a quick snack or light meal. This recipe is inspired by the flavors of Spain.
instructions: Cut the olives in half and place them on a platter.
Arrange the chorizo slices on the platter.
Slice the Epoisses cheese and place it on the platter.
Cut the oranges into wedges and arrange them on the platter.
Place the tapas crackers on the platter.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Note: This recipe is meant to be assembled just before serving, as the ingredients should be fresh and at room temperature.
